Returns the members at the gym location who have not opted in to health data and consumer-to-business (C2B) sharing. These members are excluded from all event exports, so use this endpoint to identify accounts whose previously exported data must be deleted to comply with GDPR and other data-protection requirements. The endpoint takes no query parameters and is not paginated; it returns all opted-out users for the gym location in a single response.
